title: teslalog: Updates
description: Software update history - matching TeslaMate's own Updates dashboard.

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM software_updates
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM software_updates

targets.queryText: SELECT ROUND(AVG(gap), 1) AS value FROM (SELECT julianday(start_time) - julianday(LAG(start_time) OVER (ORDER BY start_time)) AS gap FROM software_updates) WHERE gap IS NOT NULL
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ROUND(AVG(gap), 1) AS value FROM (SELECT julianday(start_time) - julianday(LAG(start_time) OVER (ORDER BY start_time)) AS gap FROM software_updates) WHERE gap IS NOT NULL

targets.queryText:
SELECT
  start_time AS time,
  version AS "Version",
  status AS "Status",
  CASE WHEN end_time IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND((julianday(end_time) - julianday(start_time)) * 1440, 0) ELSE NULL END AS "Duration (min)",
  ROUND(julianday(start_time) - julianday(LAG(start_time) OVER (ORDER BY start_time)), 1) AS "Days since previous"
FROM software_updates
ORDER BY start_time DESC
